reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Air Fit Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text:
Very good I love it 
I really like this sunscreen. The quality and texture are excellent — it feels very gentle on the skin and applies smoothly. It doesn’t leave my face shiny, which is a big plus, and it provides great protection.
reviews.zh:
好好用，我好鍾意
我真係好鍾意呢款防曬。質素同質地都一流——用喺皮膚上感覺好溫和，仲好容易推開。唔會令我塊面油光滿面，呢點好加分，而且防曬效果好強。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Air Fit Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: I highly recommend this sunscreen. I've purchased it a few times and will continue to do so. It goes on easily, feels great on skin, and cushion foundation goes on over it nicely. I find it has a faint orange citrus scent and I really like it. I usually don't prefer scented products, but again, it's faint and nice.
reviews.zh: 我極力推薦呢款防曬。我已經買咗幾次，亦都會繼續買。容易搽均，皮膚感覺好舒服，之後再搽氣墊粉底都好貼。我發覺佢有淡淡嘅橙柑橘味，我好鍾意。我通常唔鍾意有香味嘅產品，但再講多次，個味道好淡又舒服。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Air Fit Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: It has a citrusy scent and feels great on skin, goes on smooth, no white cast, didn’t break me out or irritate. It stung my eyes a little when my oily lids started to break it down halfway through the day, but it made my skin look good enough that I’m happy to keep using it.
reviews.zh: 有柑橘味，皮膚感覺好舒服，推開好滑，唔會泛白，唔會令我爆瘡或者刺激皮膚。到咗半日，我嘅油眼皮開始將佢分解嗰陣有少少拮眼，但皮膚望落夠好，所以我都樂意繼續用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Air Fit Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: The texture is on the thicker side- it’s not that thick, I just have more oily skin so it feel thicker for me vs. a more watery texture sunscreen. It does have a strong citrus smell, but it goes away quickly.
reviews.zh: 質地偏厚——其實又唔算好厚，只係我係油性肌，所以對我嚟講感覺比水狀質地嘅防曬厚。有明顯嘅柑橘味，不過好快就散去。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Air Fit Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Lo acabo de probar en la playa, no me reapliqué las suficiestes veces, pero aún así casi no me quemé, la textura es comomuna crema suave, nada pegajoso
reviews.zh: 啱啱喺沙灘試咗，雖然我冇補搽夠多次，但都幾乎冇曬傷，質地好似一般嘅潤膚霜咁滑，一啲都唔黏笠。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Air Fit Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: i love using this everyday, i have sensitive skin and this has never irritated my skin nor has it made me break out, leaves no white cast and sits beautifully under makeup. the smell is a bit strong but it does not irritate my eyes.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意日日都用，我係敏感肌，呢款從來冇刺激到我塊面，亦都冇令我爆瘡，唔會泛白，仲可以好靚咁貼住妝底。味道有少少重，但唔會刺激到我嘅眼睛。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Air Fit Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Me encanta, todas las líneas de la marca son increíbles. Había probado otros protectores solares pero este no me saco granos y no deja blanco ni nada. Tengo piel sensible y grasa con tendencia a acné y no me dejó sensación grasosa ni me irritó y lo más importante no me saco más brotes lo recomiendo al 100.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，呢個品牌所有產品線都超正。之前試過其他防曬，但呢款冇令我爆瘡，亦都唔會泛白。我係敏感肌同油性肌，仲有暗瘡傾向，但用完冇油膩感都冇刺激到我，最重要係冇令我爆多咗暗瘡，100% 推薦。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI V10 Hyal Air Fit Sunscreen 50mL
reviews.text: Es un protector muy bueno, la marca me gusta mucho y este protector contiene niacinamida que es muy bueno para mi piel grasa, su q ue creo que le vendría mejor a una piel normal a seca y tiene fragancia como olor a naranja pero no me irritó así que en general es un buen producto además que trajo un regalito 😊
reviews.zh: 係一款好嘅防曬，我好鍾意呢個品牌，呢款防曬含有煙酰胺，對我嘅油性肌好有用，我覺得佢比較適合中性至乾性肌膚，有橙味嘅香味但冇刺激到我，所以整體嚟講係一款好產品，仲送咗小禮物 😊

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
